Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

What budget should I plan for a full interior project?
Budgets vary with scope and finish level, typically ranging from a single-room refresh to a full-home build. After an initial walkthrough, we provide an itemized estimate before any design work begins, so there are no surprises later.
How long does a typical project take?
A single room can take 4–6 weeks from approval to handover; a full home typically runs 4–8 months depending on structural work. You'll receive a stage-by-stage timeline during the design and planning phase.
What happens during the first consultation?
We walk the space (or review your floor plans), discuss how you use the area day to day, and align on style, budget, and timeline. It's a working conversation, not a sales pitch — and it's free.
Can I customize designs to match my existing style?
Always. We treat your taste and existing pieces as a starting point, not an obstacle — layering in new materials and layouts while keeping what already feels like home.
